before.rule: Required link: the preceding verb governs 'de' before its object or action.

after.rule: Some verbs use de to link to what follows. Learn the verb and de together.

before.rule: Nominal binding: connects a head noun to its owner, origin, or material.

after.rule: Adds a detail about ownership, contents, material or purpose, including an action: hora de partir = time to leave.

before.rule: Subordination: bridges what someone thinks, says, or knows to the statement.

after.formulaHTML: think, say, know or hope + que + what happens
after.rule: Links what someone thinks, says, knows or hopes to a statement.

before.rule: Relativization: refers back to a noun while connecting more information.

after.rule: Adds information about the noun.

before.rule: Comparison: connects the two sides of a degree or quality difference.

after.formulaHTML: more, less or better + que + what you compare with
after.rule: Means “than” when comparing people, things or situations.

before.rule: Contraction formula pointing to a distant place or past moment.

after.rule: Combines em + aquele: “in”, “on” or “at that”. It can refer to places, things or times.

before.rule: Pronominal argument: represents 'us / to us' receiving the action of a verb.

after.rule: Refers to us: someone sees or helps us, or tells us something.

before.rule: Contraction of 'em + os' (in / on / at the) before a masculine plural noun.

after.rule: Combines em + os: “in”, “on” or “at the”, before a masculine plural noun.

before.rule: Conditional marker: introduces a hypothetical situation before its consequence.

after.formulaHTML: se + a possible situation + what happens then
after.rule: Means “if”: gives a possible situation and what happens then.

before.rule: Reflexive clitic: action reflects back onto the person doing it.

after.rule: Can mean “oneself”, or belong with a verb such as sentir-se (feel). It does not always mean “oneself”.

before.rule: Definite determiner: points to a specific masculine singular noun.

after.rule: Means “the” before a masculine singular noun, such as livro (book).

before.rule: Direct object pronoun: replaces a 3rd-person masculine singular object ('him / it').

after.rule: Refers to “him” or a masculine “it”. These examples place o before the verb; other positions also occur.

before.rule: Spatial location: anchors an action or state to an enclosed place, city, or space.

after.rule: Shows where something happens or is located.

before.rule: Temporal framing: situates an event within a month, year, or duration.

after.rule: Places an event in a time period, such as a month or year.

before.rule: Direction and destination: points toward a final physical goal or place of arrival.

after.rule: Shows where someone or something is going.

before.rule: Purpose and objective: links an intentional action to what it aims to achieve.

after.rule: Links an action to its purpose: what someone wants to do or achieve.

before.rule: Beneficiary: marks who receives or benefits from something.

after.formulaHTML: noun / noun phrase + para + a person
after.rule: Shows who something is for.

before.rule: Accompaniment: joins an action to the person or entity sharing it.

after.rule: Shows who shares an action or is together with someone.

before.rule: Instrument and manner: describes the means used or attitude applied.

after.formulaHTML: verb + com + a tool / way of doing it
after.rule: Shows the tool used or the way something is done.

before.rule: Causal ground: links an emotion, gratitude, or outcome back to its reason.

after.rule: Gives the reason for an action, feeling or result.

before.rule: Trajectory: marks the path, medium, or space through which motion occurs.

after.rule: Shows the route or place someone or something moves through.

before.rule: Contraction of 'em + o' (in the / at the) before a specific masculine noun.

after.rule: Combines em + o: “in / on / at the”.

before.rule: Contraction of 'em + a' (in the / at the) before a specific feminine noun.

after.rule: Combines em + a: “in / on / at the”.

before.rule: Contraction of 'de + o' (of the / from the) denoting possession, origin, or attribute.

after.rule: Combines de + o: “of / from the”.

before.rule: Contraction of 'de + a' (of the / from the) denoting possession, origin, or attribute.

after.rule: Combines de + a: “of / from the”.

before.rule: Simile and manner: compares the style or way an action is performed to an archetype.

after.formulaHTML: verb + como + what you compare with
after.rule: Compares how something is done with another example.

before.rule: Capacity and function: specifies the role, profession, or capacity someone acts in.

after.rule: Shows the role or job someone has in a situation.

before.rule: Adversative bridge: introduces a contrast, restriction, or unexpected limitation.

after.formulaHTML: what happens + mas + a contrasting idea
after.rule: Adds a contrasting idea or an unexpected difference.

before.rule: Directional link: points to a target destination or recipient.

after.rule: Points to a destination or recipient.

before.rule: Definite feminine article: specifies a singular feminine entity.

after.rule: Means “the”. Use the form that matches the noun’s gender and number.

before.rule: Direct object pronoun: replaces a singular 3rd-person feminine noun ('her / it').

after.rule: Refers to “her / it”. The surrounding verb and sentence show who or what is meant.

before.rule: Copulative coordinator: links equal grammatical items or consecutive actions.

after.formulaHTML: an item / idea + e + an item / idea
after.rule: Joins items, ideas or actions.

before.rule: Subject pronoun: emphasizes or clarifies the first-person singular actor.

after.rule: Means “I”. Names who does the action; the pronoun can often be left out.

before.rule: Subject pronoun: marks a 3rd-person masculine singular actor ('he / it').

after.rule: Means “he / it”. Names who does the action; the pronoun can often be left out.

before.rule: Prepositional object: follows prepositions like 'com ele' or 'para ele'.

after.rule: Refers to him after a preposition: com ele (with him), para ele (for him).

before.rule: Subject pronoun: marks a 3rd-person feminine singular actor ('she / it').

after.rule: Means “she / it”. Names who does the action; the pronoun can often be left out.

before.rule: Indefinite article: introduces an unspecific singular masculine noun.

after.rule: Means “a / an”. Use the form that matches the noun’s gender and number.

before.rule: Indefinite article: introduces an unspecific singular feminine noun.

after.rule: Means “a / an”. Use the form that matches the noun’s gender and number.

before.rule: Definite article: introduces specific masculine plural nouns.

after.rule: Means “the”. Use the form that matches the noun’s gender and number.

before.rule: Direct object pronoun: replaces 3rd-person masculine plural objects ('them').

after.rule: Refers to “them”. The surrounding verb and sentence show who or what is meant.

before.rule: Definite article: introduces specific feminine plural nouns.

after.rule: Means “the”. Use the form that matches the noun’s gender and number.

before.rule: Object pronoun: represents 'me / to me' receiving direct or indirect action.

after.rule: Refers to “me / to me”. The surrounding verb and sentence show who or what is meant.

before.rule: Reflexive clitic: action reflects back onto the speaker ('myself').

after.rule: Can mean “myself”, or belong with a verb, such as lembrar-se (remember). These examples use the after-verb form.

before.rule: Object pronoun: represents 2nd-person 'you / to you' (informal).

after.rule: Refers to “you / to you”. The surrounding verb and sentence show who or what is meant.

before.rule: Indirect object pronoun: represents 'to him / to her / to you'.

after.rule: Refers to “to him / her / you”. The surrounding verb and sentence show who or what is meant.

before.rule: Contraction of 'a + o' (to the / at the) before masculine singular nouns.

after.rule: Combines a + o: “to / at the”.

before.rule: Temporal nexus: expresses 'upon doing' or 'at the moment of'.

after.rule: Means “when” doing something; followed by the infinitive (dictionary form).

before.rule: Crasis contraction of 'a + a' (to the / at the) before feminine singular nouns.

after.rule: Combines a + a: “to / at the”.

before.rule: Contraction of 'por + o' (through the / by the / for the).

after.rule: Combines por + o: “through / by / for the”.

before.rule: Contraction of 'por + a' (through the / by the / for the).

after.rule: Combines por + a: “through / by / for the”.

before.rule: Contraction of 'em + um' (in a / on a).

after.rule: Combines em + um: “in / on / at a”.

before.rule: Contraction of 'em + uma' (in a / on a).

after.rule: Combines em + uma: “in / on / at a”.

before.rule: Possessive contraction of 'de + ele' (his / of him).

after.rule: Shows who something belongs to: “his / of him”.

before.rule: Possessive contraction of 'de + ela' (her / of her).

after.rule: Shows who something belongs to: “hers / of her”.

before.rule: Privative preposition: marks absence, exclusion, or lack.

after.formulaHTML: noun / verb + sem + what is missing
after.rule: Shows what is missing or absent.

before.rule: Thematic marker: introduces the subject matter or topic.

after.formulaHTML: verb / noun phrase + sobre + a topic
after.rule: Introduces the topic someone talks or thinks about.

before.rule: Spatial relation: located on top of a surface ('upon / above').

after.rule: Shows that something is on or above a surface.

before.rule: Terminal boundary: points to the spatial or temporal stopping point.

after.rule: Shows where a movement ends or how long something lasts.

before.rule: Scalar focus particle: emphasizes an extreme case ('even').

after.rule: Includes an example that may be surprising.

before.rule: Causal conjunction: explains the reason or motive behind an action.

after.rule: Gives the reason why something happens.

before.rule: Temporal subordinator: anchors the action to a specific time or event.

after.rule: Connects an event to the time or situation when it happens.

before.rule: Neutral demonstrative: refers to a stated fact, concept, or object near the listener.

after.rule: Refers to an idea, situation or thing already mentioned or near the listener.

before.rule: Neutral demonstrative: refers to an immediate object or idea near the speaker.

after.rule: Refers to a thing or idea close to the speaker or being introduced now.

before.rule: Universal pronoun: represents the totality of things ('everything / all').

after.rule: Refers to everything in the situation.

slot_notes.issue: The focus word is an object before no following verb here; this example needs a separate word-order pattern.

before.rule: Subordination: bridges what someone thinks, says, or knows to the statement.

before.rule: Directional goal: indicates movement toward a place or terminus.

after.rule: Shows where someone or something is going.

before.rule: Personal 'a': marks a specific human or personalized direct object.

after.rule: Used before a specific person receiving the action, as in veo a Ana (I see Ana).

before.rule: Spatial framing: anchors an action or entity within a place or space.

after.rule: Shows where something happens or is located.

after.rule: Gives the reason for an action, feeling or result.

before.rule: Trajectory: marks the route, medium, or space through which motion happens.

after.rule: Shows the route or place someone or something moves through.

before.rule: Purpose and aim: establishes the intended goal or outcome of an action.

after.rule: Links an action to its purpose: what someone wants to do or achieve.

before.rule: Beneficiary / Target: designates the person meant to receive something.

after.formulaHTML: an item / idea + para + a person
after.rule: Shows who something is for.

before.rule: Accompaniment: joins an action to the companion sharing it.

after.rule: Shows who shares an action or is together with someone.

before.rule: Instrument and attitude: describes the tool used or care applied.

after.formulaHTML: verb + con + a tool / way of doing it
after.rule: Shows the tool used or the way something is done.

before.rule: Privative preposition: marks absence, lack, or omission.

after.formulaHTML: noun / verb + sin + what is missing
after.rule: Shows what is missing or left out.

before.rule: Reflexive clitic: action turns back upon the person doing it.

after.rule: Can mean “oneself”, or belong with a verb such as sentirse (feel). It does not always mean “oneself”.

before.rule: Impersonal / Passive marker: signals general or collective truth ('one does').

after.rule: Describes what happens without naming who does it. Compare se habla (people speak) and se venden libros (books are sold).

before.rule: Object pronoun: represents 1st-person 'me / to me' receiving the verb action.

after.rule: Refers to “me / to me”. The surrounding verb and sentence show who or what is meant.

before.rule: Object pronoun: represents 2nd-person 'you / to you' (informal).

after.rule: Refers to “you / to you”. The surrounding verb and sentence show who or what is meant.

before.rule: Object pronoun: represents 1st-person plural 'us / to us'.

after.rule: Refers to us: someone sees or helps us, or tells us something.

before.rule: Indirect object pronoun: represents 3rd-person singular 'to him / to her / to you'.

after.rule: Refers to “to him / her / you”. The surrounding verb and sentence show who or what is meant.

before.rule: Mandatory contraction of 'a + el' (to the / at the) before masculine nouns.

after.rule: Here, a + el becomes al: “to the” or “at the”.

before.rule: Temporal nexus: expresses 'upon doing' or 'when doing'.

after.rule: Means “when” doing something: al llegar = when someone arrives.

before.rule: Mandatory contraction of 'de + el' (of the / from the).

after.rule: Combines de + el: “of / from the”.

before.rule: Definite article: designates a specific masculine singular referent.

after.rule: Means “the”. Use the form that matches the noun’s gender and number.

before.rule: Definite article: designates a specific feminine singular referent.

after.rule: Means “the”. Use the form that matches the noun’s gender and number.

before.rule: Direct object pronoun: replaces a 3rd-person feminine singular noun ('her / it').

after.rule: Refers to “her / it”. The surrounding verb and sentence show who or what is meant.

before.rule: Definite article: designates specific masculine plural entities.

after.rule: Means “the”. Use the form that matches the noun’s gender and number.

before.rule: Direct object pronoun: replaces 3rd-person masculine plural objects ('them').

after.rule: Refers to “them”. The surrounding verb and sentence show who or what is meant.

before.rule: Definite article: designates specific feminine plural entities.

after.rule: Means “the”. Use the form that matches the noun’s gender and number.

before.rule: Neuter article: nominalizes an adjective into an abstract quality ('the ... thing').

after.rule: With an adjective, means “the … thing” or “the … part”: lo importante = the important thing.

before.rule: Direct object pronoun: replaces a masculine singular item or concept ('it / him').

after.rule: Refers to “him”, a masculine “it”, or an idea: lo sé = I know that.

before.rule: Indefinite article: introduces a single unspecific masculine noun.

after.rule: Means “a / an”. Use the form that matches the noun’s gender and number.

before.rule: Indefinite article: introduces a single unspecific feminine noun.

after.rule: Means “a / an”. Use the form that matches the noun’s gender and number.

before.rule: Copulative conjunction: coordinates items, clauses, or thoughts of equal status.

after.formulaHTML: an item / idea + y + an item / idea
after.rule: Joins items, ideas or actions.

before.rule: Adversative bridge: introduces a qualification, limitation, or unexpected contrast.

after.formulaHTML: what happens + pero + a contrasting idea
after.rule: Adds a contrasting idea or an unexpected difference.

before.rule: Conditional marker: establishes a hypothesis preceding its outcome.

after.rule: Gives a possible situation and what happens if it is true.

before.rule: Simile and manner: compares action execution against an exemplar.

after.formulaHTML: verb + como + what you compare with
after.rule: Compares how something is done with another example.

before.rule: Capacity and role: designates the status or function held.

after.rule: Shows the role or job someone has in a situation.

before.rule: 1st-person singular possessive: introduces something belonging to the speaker.

after.rule: Shows who something belongs to: “my”.

before.rule: 3rd-person possessive: denotes something belonging to him, her, them, or formal 'you'.

after.rule: Shows who something belongs to: “his / her / their / your (formal)”.

before.rule: 2nd-person informal possessive: introduces something belonging to the listener.

after.rule: Shows who something belongs to: “your (informal)”.

before.rule: Subject pronoun: explicitly emphasizes or contrasts the 1st-person actor.

after.rule: Means “I”. Names who does the action; the pronoun can often be left out.

before.rule: Subject pronoun: explicitly clarifies or contrasts the 2nd-person actor.

after.rule: Means “you”. Names who does the action; the pronoun can often be left out.

before.rule: Neuter demonstrative: refers to a stated matter, idea, or object near the listener.

after.rule: Refers to an idea, situation or thing already mentioned or near the listener.

before.rule: Neuter demonstrative: refers to an immediate topic or object near the speaker.

after.rule: Refers to a thing or idea close to the speaker or being introduced now.

before.rule: Universal pronoun: signifies the totality of matters ('everything / all').

after.rule: Refers to everything in the situation.

before.rule: Indefinite entity: marks an unspecified thing or amount ('something').

after.rule: Refers to an unspecified thing or amount.

before.rule: Causal conjunction: explains the underlying reason or motive.

after.rule: Gives the reason why something happens.

before.rule: Temporal connector: situates an event at a point in time.

after.rule: Connects an event to the time or situation when it happens.
